title: IDOL PRE-00 Research Radar
description: Active 1.8 contract only. PRE-00 types the visual reference hierarchy as A/B/C and the audio hierarchy as X/Y/Z, verifies the X-song audience envelope and the evidence-bounded title-target intersection, preserves message and emotional progression, and carries one complete immutable natural-language MV storyline plus append-only full-text revisions. Timing remains an optional operating observation and never a creative gate. PRE-00 cannot author timecodes, camera plans, Core/Branch Cuts, prompts, Front Planning execution truth, generation truth, source acquisition, or planning-image authority.
